description: A gallery of every Slide layout an Episode can use: section slide, basic page and three columns.

slides.text: Slide layouts Every Slide layout, one Slide each.
Section slide Title and caption, vertically centred. It opens every Section and names it.
Basic page Title and caption up top, one block of prose below. The prose is a target a Speaker note can name, like the title and the caption.

Three columns Title and caption up top, exactly three keyed columns below. First column Each column has a slug, and its slug is the target a note names it by. Second column Columns hold a title and prose, never a position. Third column A fourth column is a different layout.

notes.text: This panel shows the speaker notes and voice script for the Slide you are reading, and follows you as you scroll. Press Alt+N to open or close it.
Section slide No speaker notes for this Slide.
Basic page The prose target Layouts offer targets for free: title, caption and prose. Name one in a note's target and the drawer highlights it.
Three columns A column is a target Each column's slug doubles as its target, so a note can point at one column.

script.text: This panel shows the speaker notes and voice script for the Slide you are reading, and follows you as you scroll. Press Alt+N to open or close it.
